name: V.G. Re-birth
source:
A visual novel game in which the player plays the part of a reporter working on a story about the V.G. competition. The game also introduces the new character Sakuragi Hiyori. Depending on the choices the player makes, he/she will be paired with Yuka, Tamao or Reimi.

V.G. Rebirth Dash:
An update to V.G. Rebirth which includes nearly every other non-boss character (Yuuki Ayako is absent as she is a lesbian) as an option to pair with the player. It also introduces the new character Hatano Keiko.

[Edited From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Variable_Geo#Games]Wikipedia[/url].]
